Assume closing at the start of the year, fixed issue price, no synergies, no fees, no purchase-accounting charges and no other earnings or share changes. Both earnings figures are after tax. What is full-year pro forma EPS, in dollars per share?
instances.spoken_text: An analyst builds a simple merger EPS model. The buyer has annual net income of seventy-five million dollars and eighty million common shares priced at twenty dollars each. The target earns forty million dollars annually and has ten million shares. The offer is sixty-five dollars per target share, paid entirely in new buyer shares issued at the stated buyer price. Assume closing at the start of the year, fixed issue price, no synergies, no fees, no purchase-accounting charges and no other earnings or share changes. Both earnings figures are after tax. What is full-year pro forma EPS, in dollars per share?

follow_up.question: Why can an all-stock acquisition be EPS-accretive without synergies?
follow_up.reference: The buyer may issue shares at a higher earnings multiple than the multiple paid for the target. EPS accretion from that arithmetic alone does not establish that the transaction creates economic value.
